review.body: { let result = recognize (history) ; if result . first_refusal . is_some () { super :: refused () ; } result }
review.item_premise: This body checks or returns public burn publication and candidate data. Trace records complete arguments and results, including the retained prefix and first refusal; explicit refusal wins over the successful report return. The declared verifier is trusted and local fixtures are not chain evidence. No secret or exporter handle enters this body.
